en-US.title: Trim Workout
en-US.subtitle: Log sets. Follow a plan
en-US.description:
Trim is a workout logger built around your plan. Open today's day and log one set at a time.

PLAN
• Plans made of training days, each with exercises, sets and reps
• Start from a starter plan, or build your own
• 200+ built-in exercises, plus your own custom exercises

LOG
• One set at a time, with what you lifted last time
• A rest timer that starts when you log a set
• A workout in progress stays saved if you leave or close the app
• kg or lbs

REVIEW
• History of every completed workout, with personal records
• Progress: estimated 1RM for each lift, and body check-ins

Your data stays on your iPhone. No account, no sign-in.

TRIM PRO
Logging is free. The free version includes one plan, your full workout history, and the last 3 months of Progress.

Trim Pro adds:
• Unlimited plans, and switching between them
• Progress beyond 3 months, plus body trends
• Next-session targets

Trim Pro is an optional auto-renewable subscription, billed monthly or yearly. The yearly option includes a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.

Privacy Policy: https://scratch-legal.vercel.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
en-US.releaseNotes: First release of Trim: plans, one-set-at-a-time logging with last time and a rest timer, history with personal records, Progress, and Trim Pro.

review.notes:
No account or login is needed. Every feature works without signing in, and all workout data stays on the device.

Trim Pro is an auto-renewable subscription (monthly, or yearly with a 7-day free trial) bought in the in-app paywall. Prices load from StoreKit through RevenueCat. Each Pro gate opens the same paywall:
1. Settings tab > Trim Pro.
2. Plans tab > + (after the first plan exists) opens "Add another plan". Free users keep one plan.
3. Finish a first workout: Workout tab > Start on a day > Log set > Finish > Done. The paywall opens once after the first completed workout.
4. Progress tab > tap a lift (after logging a workout) > the 6M, YTD or All chip. Free shows the last 3 months.
5. Progress tab > Log check-in > tap a body metric > "Trends over time with Trim Pro".
6. Next-session targets: shown during logging for Pro users; free users see the Pro prompt there.

Restore Purchases is in the paywall footer and in Settings. Terms of Use (Apple standard EULA) and Privacy Policy are linked from the paywall footer and Settings.
